messages:
sofia: FYI canary for gptx-awq-actq on staging started to emit repeated token loops and some <unk>-like tokens. saw the first spike during low-volume traffic around 09:12. :warning:

deploy-bot: Canary deploy 1768049999 for model gptx-awq-actq v1.2.0 -> FAILED health-check (latency p95/p99 spike, several 5xxs).

john: Can you paste the tail logs where the loop shows up?

sofia: here's a small snippet from the decode trace:```TRACE 09:12:14 decode_step=140 token=50256 next=50256 next=50256 ... repeated 40x; attention_weights nan after step 145; kv-index mismatch observed in trace id=ct-7f3a``` Also p99 latency jumped from 210ms -> 980ms around same time.

lee: Did we change group_size / act-quant params in this canary? IIRC the bake used group_size=128 and actq_enabled=true.

eva: I repro'd locally with the canary config on a small sample. Turning actq off removes the repeat loop immediately.

john: interesting. Hypothesis: AWQ act-quantification with group_size=128 is causing accumulator / scaling rounding that interacts with softmax -> leads to repeated tokens / KV cache misalignment.

sofia: quick mitigation options: 1) rollback the canary (safe) 2) pin group_size to 64 and re-rollout 3) disable actq entirely. Which is least impact to latency/throughput?

eva: disabling actq is the safest but costs ~1.8x throughput on our microbench. group_size=64 gives ~1.15x overhead vs baseline and appears to keep accuracy similar in small tests.

lee: proposal: rollback now, then run a focused bakeoff grid: group_size in [32,64,96], actq on/off, short-run 50k tokens each, check instability count + quality deltas.

sofia: sounds good. Plan: revert canary -> run bakeoff against production-sampled prompts + eval set, measure repeat-loop count, BLEU/ROUGE deltas, latency P99. I'll orchestrate overnight.

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by @sofia at 09:34:02. Canary traffic scaled to 0%.

john: post-rollback logs look clean; error rates back to baseline. Please capture artifacts for postmortem.

sofia: collecting traces and will upload artifacts to: /mnt/experiments/awq/1768049999/ (contains decode traces, kv dumps, perf profiles and the bakeoff config).

eva: repro command for local runs:```python tools/run_quant_serve.py --model gptx --quant awq --group 128 --actq --seed 42 --input tests/samples.json --log-level debug``` Add --no-stream to simplify traces.

lee: when running experiments, please enable KV dump: export AWQ_DUMP_KV=1 so we can diff KV indices between runs. Also instrument p(token repetition) metric.

sofia: first quick pass results: group_size=96 with actq enabled stayed stable on 100k tokens sample, instability count ~0.0001 per token (baseline ~0.00008). Quality delta: +0.4% BLEU (small improvement). group_size=128 reproduced loops.

john: ok good signal. Might be a threshold effect around 120. For safety set canary traffic to 0.5% and try group_size=96 canary with tight rollback rule.

eva: added console alert: if instability rate >0.0003 per 10k tokens or p95 latency > 500ms -> auto rollback.

sofia: I'll schedule the 200k-token overnight run on the grid and post full numbers in morning. For now I've pinned the model to group_size=96 in the staging canary config and limited traffic to 0.5%.

lee: also add a quick unit test in decode pipeline to fail if attention_weights produce NaNs after softmax under quantized path.

sofia: noted. Thanks all — will follow up with a summary + artifact links tomorrow morning. :coffee:
